Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and proteinuria is noted, but no casts or ketones. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
